prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Data analyst
We are looking for an experienced data analyst who can organise our data within Zoho (Books, Creator, CRM, Subscriptions, etc.) to produce meaningful reports using Zoho Analytics at the request of our marketing, operations and finance teams. The ideal candidate will have SQL experience and will be able to convert a brief from the relevant stakeholders into an easily digestible format to help us make informed decisions at a senior management level. This is an ongoing, long-term opportunity to work alongside a fast growing, tech enabled start-up in the home repairs space. We serve the UK market and have operations in London and South Africa.
</job>

text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data analyst with 5 years of experience helping teams turn messy data into clear, actionable reporting. I’d be glad to support your team in organising data across Zoho Books, Creator, CRM, Subscriptions, and related systems so your marketing, operations, and finance stakeholders can get reliable reports in Zoho Analytics and make better decisions at senior management level.

My background includes SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard building, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m comfortable taking a brief from multiple stakeholders, translating it into a structured reporting approach, and presenting the output in an easily digestible format that supports day-to-day decision-making as well as higher-level review. I also understand the importance of building reporting that is consistent, easy to maintain, and useful across different functions.

One project I’d highlight is Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare in e-commerce. I built a solution that joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit using SQL and Looker Studio. That work helped reallocate 18% of the ad budget and contributed to a 12% decrease in customer acquisition cost the next quarter.

That experience is relevant to your needs because it involved combining data from different sources, cleaning and structuring it for analysis, and creating reporting that stakeholders could actually use. I’m used to working with data that needs to be organised carefully before it becomes meaningful, and I enjoy building dashboards and reports that make patterns easier to see.

I’d be excited about the opportunity to work with your fast-growing, tech-enabled home repairs business on an ongoing basis. The mix of marketing, operations, and finance reporting is exactly the kind of cross-functional data work I enjoy, and I’d be happy to help you create a reporting setup that supports both immediate needs and long-term growth.

If helpful, I can start by understanding your current Zoho setup, identifying the key reporting requirements, and mapping those into a practical analytics structure.
